contradictions.what: Rep says it was decided before we got in the room and nothing could be done, yet our analysis landed three weeks late, after the test finished, and contained fixable findings.
Rep calls the account healthy and not on anybody's list, but did not know about the new head of payments, and Stefan says we only reached out when he said he was leaving.
Rep says nobody wanted to rip anything out and they like the product, yet the customer asked to split the contract and moved part of the business to local acquiring.
Rep says we weren't really pitching because it was a renewal, but then describes answering with the Authorization Boost deck and uplift average.

Rep says it was decided before we got in the room and the CFO approved two weeks before the last call, but also says we learned of the evaluation only at the renewal notice, so timing of 'before' is unclear.

dodges.question: Which ones? (which international markets looked bad)
dodges.what: Said 'I don't know exactly', named Brazil and a couple in Europe, and never saw his analysis.

dodges.question: Which part of our pitch got a reaction, and which got silence?
dodges.what: Said 'we weren't really pitching' and described product goodwill; named only the uplift number as silence and gave no reaction-getting part.

dodges.question: When did you first feel this was lost? What happened right before?
dodges.what: Answered 'I don't think there was a moment' and then later described late analysis, a missing named contact and Stefan's leaving comment.
